============================================================\n","# ENTROPY CALCULATION\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def entropy(data):\n","    if len(data) == 0:\n","        return 0\n","    counts = Counter(data)\n","    probs = [v / len(data) for v in counts.values()]\n","    return -sum(p * math.log2(p) for p in probs)\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# LOGISTIC MAP\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def logistic_map(x0, banyak):\n","\n","    x = x0\n","\n","    for i in range(1000):\n","        x = 3.923 * x * (1 - x)\n","\n","    barisan = np.zeros(banyak, dtype=np.int32)\n","\n","    for i in range(banyak):\n","\n","        x = 3.923 * x * (1 - x)\n","\n","        barisan[i] = int(x * 1000 % 256)\n","\n","    return barisan\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# KEY GENERATION\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def kunci(n, x0, ed='e'):\n","\n","    banyak = int(n * (n - 1) / 2)\n","\n","    barisan = logistic_map(x0, banyak + n - 1)\n","\n","    msa = np.eye(n, dtype=np.int32)\n","\n","    indeks = 0\n","\n","    # ========================================================\n","    # UPPER TRIANGULAR\n","    # ========================================================\n","\n","    for i in range(n):\n","        for j in range(i + 1, n):\n","\n","            msa[i, j] = barisan[indeks]\n","\n","            indeks += 1\n","\n","    # ========================================================\n","    # LOWER TRIANGULAR\n","    # ========================================================\n","\n","    for lower triangle\n","        for baris in range(1, n):\n","\n","            augmented[baris] = (\n","                r_ij(\n","                    augmented,\n","                    baris,\n"," ============================================================\n","\n","def rsa_decrypt(data, private_key_file=\"private.pem\"):\n","\n","    with open(private_key_file, \"rb\") as f:\n"," vs Encrypted vs Decrypted\n","# Metrics:\n","# - SHA-256 Integrity\n","# - Shannon Entropy\n","# - Byte Frequency Distribution\n","# - Chi-Square Test\n","# - Pearson Correlation\n","# - Basic Statistical Summary\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","!pip install numpy\n","\n","import numpy as np\n","import hashlib\n","import math\n","from collections import Counter\n","from google.colab import files\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# FILE LOADER\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def load_file(prompt):\n","    print(prompt)\n","    uploaded = files.upload()\n","    filename = list(uploaded.keys())[0]\n","    data = np.fromfile(filename, dtype=np.uint8)\n","    return filename, data\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# SHA-256 HASH\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def sha256_file(filename):\n","    h = hashlib.sha256()\n","    with open(filename, \"rb\") as f:\n","        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(4096), b\"\"):\n","            h.update(chunk)\n","    return h.hexdigest()\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# ENTROPY\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def entropy(data):\n","    if len(data) == 0:\n","        return 0.0\n","\n","    counts = Counter(data)\n","    probs = np.array([c / len(data) for c in counts.values()])\n","\n","    return -np.sum(probs * np.log2(probs))\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# BYTE FREQUENCY\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def byte_frequency(data):\n","    freq = np.zeros(256)\n","    for b in data:\n","        freq[b] += 1\n","    return freq / len(data)\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# CHI-SQUARE TEST\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def chi_square(data):\n","    freq = np.zeros(256)\n","\n","    for b in data:\n","        freq[b] += 1\n","\n","    expected = len(data) / 256\n","\n","    chi = np.sum((freq - expected) ** 2 / (expected + 1e-9))\n","\n","    return chi\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# PEARSON CORRELATION\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def correlation(data1, data2):\n","\n","    min_len = min(len(data1), len(data2))\n","\n","    x = data1[:min_len].astype(np.float64)\n","    y = data2[:min_len].astype(np.float64)\n","\n","    if len(x) == 0:\n","        return 0\n","\n","    return np.corrcoef(x, y)[0, 1]\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# ANALYSIS ENGINE\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def analyze(name, data, filename=None):\n","\n","    print(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*60)\n","    print(f\"ANALYSIS: {name}\")\n","    print(\"=\"*60)\n","\n","    print(f\"Size: {len(data)} bytes\")\n","    print(f\"Entropy: {entropy(data):.6f}\")\n","    print(f\"Chi-Square: {chi_square(data):.6f}\")\n","\n","    if filename:\n","        print(f\"SHA-256: {sha256_file(filename)}\")\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# MAIN PIPELINE\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","print(\"============================================================\")\n","print(\"CRYPTOGRAPHIC SECURITY ANALYSIS TOOL\")\n","print(\"Original vs Encrypted vs Decrypted File Comparison\")\n","print(\"============================================================\")\n","\n","# Upload files\n","orig_file, orig = load_file(\"Upload ORIGINAL file\")\n","enc_file, enc = load_file(\"Upload ENCRYPTED file\")\n","dec_file, dec = load_file(\"Upload DECRYPTED file\")\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# INDIVIDUAL ANALYSIS\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","analyze(\"ORIGINAL FILE\", orig, orig_file)\n","analyze(\"ENCRYPTED FILE\", enc, enc_file)\n","analyze(\"DECRYPTED FILE\", dec, dec_file)\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# CORRELATION ANALYSIS\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","print(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*60)\n","print(\"CROSS CORRELATION ANALYSIS\")\n","print(\"=\"*60)\n","\n","print(\"Original vs Encrypted:\", correlation(orig, enc))\n","print(\"Original vs Decrypted:\", correlation(orig, dec))\n","print(\"Encrypted vs Decrypted:\", correlation(enc, dec))\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# INTEGRITY CHECK\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","print(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*60)\n","print(\"INTEGRITY CHECK (SHA-256)\")\n","print(\"=\"*60)\n","\n","print(\"Original  :\", sha256_file(orig_file))\n","print(\"Decrypted :\", sha256_file(dec_file))\n","\n","if sha256_file(orig_file) == sha256_file(dec_file):\n","    print(\"RESULT: FILES ARE IDENTICAL (SUCCESS)\")\n","else:\n","    print(\"RESULT: FILES ARE DIFFERENT (FAIL)\")\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# SUMMARY INSIGHT\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","print(\"\\n\" + ============================================================\n","# Q1-LEVEL CRYPTOGRAPHIC SECURITY ANALYSIS SUITE (COLAB)\n","# Enhanced for Scopus Q1 Paper Standards\n","# ============================================================\n","# Metrics Included:\n","# - SHA-256 Integrity\n","# - Shannon Entropy\n","# - Byte Frequency Distribution\n","# - Chi-Square Test\n","# - Pearson Correlation\n","# - NPCR (Number of Pixel Change Rate generalized for bytes)\n","# - UACI (Unified Average Change Intensity generalized)\n","# - Avalanche Effect (bit-level)\n","# - Histogram Visualization\n","# - Comparative Tables (Pandas)\n","# - CSV Export for Journal Submission\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","!pip install numpy pandas matplotlib\n","\n","import numpy as np\n","import hashlib\n","import math\n","import pandas as pd\n","import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n","from collections import Counter\n","from google.colab import files\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# FILE LOADER\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def load_file(prompt):\n","    print(prompt)\n","    uploaded = files.upload()\n","    filename = list(uploaded.keys())[0]\n","    data = np.fromfile(filename, dtype=np.uint8)\n","    return filename, data\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# SHA-256\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def sha256_file(filename):\n","    h = hashlib.sha256()\n","    with open(filename, \"rb\") as f:\n","        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(4096), b\"\"):\n","            h.update(chunk)\n","    return h.hexdigest()\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# ENTROPY\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def entropy(data):\n","    if len(data) == 0:\n","        return 0\n","    counts = Counter(data)\n","    probs = np.array([c / len(data) for c in counts.values()])\n","    return -np.sum(probs * np.log2(probs))\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# CHI-SQUARE\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def chi_square(data):\n","    freq = np.zeros(256)\n","    for b in data:\n","        freq[b] += 1\n","    expected = len(data) / 256\n","    return np.sum((freq - expected) ** 2 / (expected + 1e-9))\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# CORRELATION\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def correlation(a, b):\n","    n = min(len(a), len(b))\n","    if n == 0:\n","        return 0\n","    return np.corrcoef(a[:n], b[:n])[0, 1]\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# NPCR (GENERALIZED BYTE VERSION)\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def npcr(a, b):\n","    n = min(len(a), len(b))\n","    diff = np.sum(a[:n] != b[:n])\n","    return (diff / n) * 100\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# UACI (GENERALIZED BYTE VERSION)\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def uaci(a, b):\n","    n = min(len(a), len(b))\n","    if n == 0:\n","        return 0\n","    return np.mean(np.abs(a[:n] - b[:n]) / 255) * 100\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# AVALANCHE EFFECT (BIT LEVEL)\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def avalanche(a, b):\n","    n = min(len(a), len(b))\n","    if n == 0:\n","        return 0\n","    xor = np.bitwise_xor(a[:n], b[:n])\n","    bit_changes = np.unpackbits(xor).sum()\n","    total_bits = n * 8\n","    return (bit_changes / total_bits) * 100\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# BYTE HISTOGRAM\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def plot_hist(data, title):\n","    plt.figure()\n","    plt.hist(data, bins=256)\n","    plt.title(title)\n","    plt.xlabel(\"Byte Value\")\n","    plt.ylabel(\"Frequency\")\n","    plt.show()\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# ANALYSIS ENGINE\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def analyze(name, data, filename=None):\n","    print(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*70)\n","    print(f\"ANALYSIS: {name}\")\n","    print(\"=\"*70)\n","\n","    print(\"Size:\", len(data))\n","    print(\"Entropy:\", entropy(data))\n","    print(\"Chi-Square:\", chi_square(data))\n","\n","    if filename:\n","        print(\"SHA-256:\", sha256_file(filename))\n","\n","    plot_hist(data, name)\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# TABLE GENERATOR\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def summary_table(orig, enc, dec):\n","\n","    df = pd.DataFrame([\n","        [\"Original\", entropy(orig), chi_square(orig), len(orig)],\n","        [\"Encrypted\", entropy(enc), chi_square(enc), len(enc)],\n","        [\"Decrypted\", entropy(dec), chi_square(dec), len(dec)]\n","    ], columns=[\"File\", \"Entropy\", \"ChiSquare\", \"Size\"])\n","\n","    print(\"\\nSUMMARY TABLE\")\n","    print(df)\n","\n","    df.to_csv(\"security_summary.csv\", index=False)\n","\n","    return df\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# MAIN PIPELINE\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","print(\"============================================================\")\n","print(\"Q1-LEVEL CRYPTOGRAPHIC SECURITY ANALYSIS SUITE\")\n","print(\"============================================================\")\n","\n","orig_file, orig = load_file(\"Upload ORIGINAL file\")\n","enc_file, enc = load_file(\"Upload ENCRYPTED file\")\n","dec_file, dec = load_file(\"Upload DECRYPTED file\")\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# INDIVIDUAL ANALYSIS\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","analyze(\"ORIGINAL\", orig, orig_file)\n","analyze(\"ENCRYPTED\", enc, enc_file)\n","analyze(\"DECRYPTED\", dec, dec_file)\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# COMPARATIVE ANALYSIS\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","print(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*70)\n","print(\"COMPARATIVE ANALYSIS\")\n","print(\"=\"*70)\n","\n","print(\"Correlation O-E:\", correlation(orig, enc))\n","print(\"Correlation O-D:\", correlation(orig, dec))\n","print(\"Correlation E-D:\", correlation(enc, dec))\n","\n","print(\"NPCR O-E:\", npcr(orig, enc), \"%\")\n","print(\"UACI O-E:\", uaci(orig, enc), \"%\")\n","print(\"Avalanche O-E:\", avalanche(orig, enc), \"%\")\n","\n","print(\"NPCR O-D:\", npcr(orig, dec), \"%\")\n","print(\"UACI O-D:\", uaci(orig, dec), \"%\")\n","print(\"Avalanche O-D:\", avalanche(orig, dec), \"%\")\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# SHA-256 INTEGRITY\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","print(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*70)\n","print(\"INTEGRITY CHECK\")\n","print(\"=\"*70)\n","\n","print(\"Original :\", sha256_file(orig_file))\n","print(\"Decrypted:\", sha256_file(dec_file))\n","\n","if sha256_file(orig_file) == sha256_file(dec_file):\n","    print(\"RESULT: PERFECT RECOVERY\")\n","else:\n","    print(\"RESULT: MISMATCH\")\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# SUMMARY TABLE\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","summary_table(orig, enc, dec)\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# FINAL INSIGHT\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","print(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*70)\n","print(\"Q1 PAPER INSIGHT\")\n","print(\"=\"*70)\n","\n","print(\"1. High entropy (~8) indicates strong randomness\")\n","print(\"2. Low correlation (~0) indicates strong diffusion\")\n","print(\"3. High NPCR (>99%) indicates strong sensitivity\")\n","print(\"4.
